title: The Last Harbor Revisited
author: Freya Delacroix
blurb: Hazel Eastwick, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
